mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bc_trade_order_${shard} (id, order_no, user_id, order_type, total_cent, status, seckill_activity_id) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.orderNo}, #{row.userId}, #{row.orderType}, #{row.totalCent}, #{row.status}, #{row.seckillActivityId})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, o.order_type AS orderType, o.total_cent AS totalCent, o.status, o.seckill_activity_id AS seckillActivityId, o.created_at AS createdAt FROM bc_trade_order_0 o JOIN bc_trade_order_item_0 i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.user_id = o.user_id JOIN bc_product_sku k ON k.id = i.sku_id JOIN bc_product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id WHERE p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} UNION ALL SELECT o.id, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.user_id AS userId, o.order_type AS orderType, o.total_cent AS totalCent, o.status, o.seckill_activity_id AS seckillActivityId, o.created_at AS createdAt FROM bc_trade_order_1 o JOIN bc_trade_order_item_1 i ON i.order_id = o.id AND i.user_id = o.user_id JOIN bc_product_sku k ON k.id = i.sku_id JOIN bc_product_spu p ON p.id = k.spu_id WHERE p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} ) t ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
